outcome: composite maternal outcomes (eclampsia, abruptio placentae, pulmonary oedema, or renal failure)
cohort: 201 women with singleton pregnancies diagnosed with pre-eclampsia between 28 and 34 weeks' gestation in a tertiary centre in south India
finding: Imminent symptoms and multiparity were associated with composite adverse maternal outcomes, while low birth weight and breech vaginal delivery were associated with perinatal mortality.
mod_finding: Breech vaginal delivery was associated with perinatal mortality.
birth_weight: Low birth weight (specific values not provided)
